scoring.unknownRule: Not visible, not retrieved or not inspected is null, never zero or an assumed pass. Record observedWeight. Keep total and grade null until every required criterion is inspected; do not normalize a partial score to 100.
scoring.criticalRule: Any critical defect blocks acceptance and continuation regardless of weighted total. Show FAIL - critical defect alongside any completed numeric score; never present an A/B grade alone for a critical failure.
scoring.evidenceRule: Every score needs a concrete observation against the scoped original and an output ID/path. No scores from model self-description. Record reviewer and time.
